propertySets.name: Pset_ElementAssemblyTypeTurnoutPanel
propertySets.definition: Turnout panel properties used in railway. The property set can be used by the predefined type TURNOUT_PANEL of IfcElementAssembly.

properties.name: IsAccessibleByVehicle
properties.definition: Indicates whether the element is accessible by a vehicle or not.

properties.name: BranchLineDirection
properties.definition: Describes the direction associated to the branch line of the turnout (deviated branch).

properties.name: TrackExpansion
properties.definition: In curvature context, bounded value of the expansion distance that can be added to rail gauge.

properties.name: TurnoutCurvedRadius
properties.definition: If turnout is curved, the main branch radius of curvature.

properties.name: TypeOfCurvedTurnout
properties.definition: Turnouts that are positioned in the curved part of the alignment.

properties.name: InstallationPlan
properties.definition: Reference to external information source about installation or construction plan of the element.

properties.name: IsSharedTurnout
properties.definition: Indicates if the turnout makes a connection to another infrastructure owner (for sharing costs).

properties.name: MaximumSpeedLimitOfDivergingLine
properties.definition: Maximum speed for diverging line that corresponds to the type of turnout and design constraints.

properties.name: TypeOfDrivingDevice
properties.definition: Type of the driving device used for the turnout.

properties.name: TrackElementOrientation
properties.definition: Turnout panels can be placed in 2 mirror-symmetric directions in the field. To distinguish both ends of the turnout panel, a definition of an orientation system with respect to the panel is necessary. The orientation defines, if the panel is oriented in a way or opposite with respect to the direction of the alignment/stationing.

properties.name: PercentShared
properties.definition: Percent of costs paid by the other infrastructure owner.

properties.name: TrackGaugeLength
properties.definition: Basic track gauge of permanent way.

properties.name: TurnoutPointMachineCount
properties.definition: Count of point machines inside turnout panel.

properties.name: TurnoutHeaterType
properties.definition: Defines the kind of turnout heater installed.

properties.name: TypeOfJunction
properties.definition: The turnout part of the continuous welded rail.
